The '''Darstai'is Sickle''' was a curved blade wielded by the [[Sayormi]] [[Cyrans]] the Unfeeling. Cyrans had honed the blade to perfection, so it cut with only the slightest bit of pressure. He took great care to keep his weapon in the best condition possible at all times.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Kerritamba]] to kill Cyrans the Unfeeling took the two-handed weapon from Cyran's dead body.

==Behind the scenes==
Darstai'is Sickle was a weapon in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion pack to [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players could loot it from Cyrans the Unfeeling in the [[Dead Forest (Kashyyyk)|Dead Forest]] region on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] prior to the games closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
